StackType.rationale: PowerStackType.Counter. The sim has no StackType concept; Power.on_stack (powers.py:64-66) adds unconditionally, which is what PowerCmd.ModifyAmount does (PowerCmd.cs:236). Third-file citations, not hashed here.

BeforeSideTurnStart.issue: RE-EXECUTED 2026-07-30, still open, sharpened. DIVERGENCE: AggressionPower.cs:28 is `source.ToList().UnstableShuffle(Rng.CombatCardSelection).Take(Amount)` -- an UnstableShuffle (full Fisher-Yates, len-1 draws) on the dedicated CombatCardSelection stream. powers.py:704 (current line, method renamed from on_player_turn_start to before_side_turn_start since this entry was drafted) is still `combat._rng.sample(candidates, min(self.amount, len(candidates)))` -- Python's reservoir-sampling `random.sample` on `combat._rng`, the shared unseeded legacy random.Random (combat.py), not a per-purpose accessor. OBSERVABLE: two independent wrongnesses stack. (1) Stream: the draw does not come off `combat.combat_rng.card_selection` -- confirmed present and wired for exactly this purpose (combat_rng.py:21 `"card_selection": "combat_card_selection"`, exposed as the `.card_selection` property) but unused by this power -- so an Aggression turn consumes zero draws from CombatCardSelection and instead perturbs the shared rng, desyncing every later legacy-rng draw in the run. (2) Algorithm/draw-count: `random.sample(candidates, k)` performs a partial (reservoir-style) selection of exactly k draws' worth of internal state, where `UnstableShuffle(rng).Take(k)` performs a FULL Fisher-Yates over ALL of `candidates` (len(candidates)-1 swaps) before truncating to k -- a different number of RNG calls even when `len(candidates) == k`, per this wave's calibration note and the already-closed sibling gap at `power/hello_world`'s `g3` (HelloWorldPower.cs:27, fixed 2026-07-29 by switching to `combat.combat_rng.card_gen.shuffle(pool)` then `pool[:n]`, powers.py:3279-3282 in the current file). So even a replay that happens to move the same cards leaves the shared rng and the CombatCardSelection stream in the wrong place for every subsequent draw -- conformance-visible on any string-seeded replay that plays Aggression. TRIGGER: Aggression is a ported, registered Ironclad Rare Power card (cards/aggression.py, `@register_card`, cost 1, `PowerCmd.apply(ctx.hooks, ctx.player, AggressionPower, 1, applier=ctx.player)` on play) -- a normal deck card reachable from any card reward or shop, so this fires on any seed where the player plays and keeps Aggression with at least one Attack in the discard pile. FIX: replace `combat._rng.sample(candidates, min(self.amount, len(candidates)))` with a shuffle-then-slice on `combat.combat_rng.card_selection`, mirroring the already-landed HelloWorldPower fix (`combat.combat_rng.card_gen.shuffle(pool); pool[:n]`) but on the `card_selection` accessor instead of `card_gen`. RADIUS: `cards/pool.py:181`'s `take_random(items, count, rng)` helper is the other existing UnstableShuffle+Take port in the codebase and is a candidate shared implementation for both this fix and any other unconverted `.sample(` site. The SLOT half remains correct: C# dispatches AfterDeath's sibling BeforeSideTurnStart pre-draw (CombatManager.cs:458) and the sim's `before_side_turn_start` (player.py:200) is now a dedicated, correctly-named hook (hooks.py:101 `"before_side_turn_start": "BeforeSideTurnStart"`) firing before `on_player_turn_start`/BeforeHandDraw (player.py:258) -- a slot-naming improvement since this entry was drafted, and not itself a divergence.
